---
title: Add Stamp Card
description: >-
  Enable the stamp feature, configure daily earning limits, upload custom
  designs, and link stamps directly to purchases of specific products.
---
<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="1374" height="759" style="width: 1374px; height: auto; cursor: pointer;" />

## Step

1. Navigate to Incentives > Stamp > Add Stamp Card.

<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="321" height="209" style="width: 321px; height: auto; cursor: pointer;" />

2. Enable stamp feature and set limits on how many stamps a member can earn daily.

<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="484" height="336" style="width: 484px; height: auto; cursor: pointer;" />

3. Enter stamp card details, upload custom stamp design and click Save to activate.

<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="504" height="375" style="width: 504px; height: auto; cursor: pointer;" />

4. **Optional:&#x20;**&#x73;elect specific existing products and set exactly how many stamps a customer earns for each one they purchase.

<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="535" height="352" style="width: 535px; height: auto; cursor: pointer;" />
